# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (Amsterdam, Netherlands) builds arboreal robots for agriculture and helps growers choose the right farm robot.

Olivabot is a Dutch company. We build robots that work in tree canopies (Gibbon Bot, field-tested in olive groves) and we advise farms and agritech teams on which agricultural robots can actually help now.

## Choose the right farm robot

- [Agriculture robotics consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/agriculture-robotics.html): 45-minute call + written report, €500 excl. VAT. Independent advice for growers, farm managers, cooperatives, and agritech teams in the EU. Not a vendor pitch.
